dedupe_keys.name: japan prefectural co2 and socioeconomic inventory 2007 2015

description: This Figshare collection links Japan's prefectural fossil-fuel carbon emissions to socioeconomic attributes from 2007 to 2015. Its two child workbooks separate emissions from contextual measures, and the collection description identifies 47 prefectures, three fuel groups and 26 sectors. These tables can help calibrate regional energy transition or industrial-emissions scenarios and compare simulated allocations across prefectures. They are accounting estimates, not direct point-source measurements. The nine-year historical span and allocation rules limit their use for current conditions; users should check how electricity generated in one prefecture is assigned. Both member records and the collection registration state CC BY 4.0. I read the own metadata and descriptor but did not open spreadsheet cells or reproduce calculations. The related later China emission accounts are a separate geographic source, not a duplicate. No exact catalogue coverage was identified.
